finding: No verified local or regimen-specific source in the audited records authorises converting the national metoclopramide row to a default PRN/rescue plan. The PRN interpretation was a pre-existing template assumption, also incorrectly accepted in the 23 November clinical review.

sources.title: NCCP NCIS Antiemetic Medicines, v8, 10 February2025
sources.reviewed: Rendered Table1 on p4 and extracted text; p3 individual-prescriber discretion also reviewed
sources.comparison: Moderate/low rows explicitly append prn; the dedicated carboplatin/trastuzumab-deruxtecan row does not.
sources.interpretation: Reproduce unqualified three-times-daily frequency as the national reference; retain prescriber completion of exact days and duration. Patient-specific discretion is not evidence of an existing approved PRN default. The neighbouring dexamethasone days do not specify metoclopramide duration.

sources.title: EMA metoclopramide-containing medicines referral
sources.relevance: Supports adult delayed chemotherapy-related nausea/vomiting prevention and treatment, a maximum five-day course, individual dose limits and neurological adverse-effect counselling. It does not authorise replacing the dedicated NCCP schedule with PRN by default.

pre_existing_template_evidence.existing_instruction: Rescue use / duration to be completed by prescriber

audit_correction.supersedes_only: The metoclopramide rescue/default-PRN interpretation in the earlier support-drug table and subsequent patient/video wording
audit_correction.other_source_and_clinical_findings: No other earlier conclusion is changed by this correction

safe_reference.timing: Subsequent days; exact days and duration to be completed by prescriber
safe_reference.individualisation: When-needed use requires an explicit individual or local prescribing instruction. Follow the issued personal prescription; do not self-adjust.
safe_reference.duration_boundary: Do not invent Days2–4 from the adjacent dexamethasone line. Short-term maximum five-day licensing limit is not an instruction to give a fixed five-day course.

outstanding_at_this_record: Authenticated additive logistics source transition; scoped publication, PDF regeneration, visual/mirror/QR verification and a new asset freeze
approval_boundary: This is source/software verification, not independent human oncology/pharmacy signoff.
